senses.gloss: to split, perforate (cmp. פצם), esp. to prick an animal’s mouth with the bit; to govern.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 23:16">Num. XXIII, 16</cite>) ‘he put a thing in his mouth’ <he>כאדם שנותן … ופוֹקְמָהּ להיכן שירצה</he> as a man puts a bit in the mouth of a beast and makes it go in what direction he desires; <he>כך הקב״ה פוֹקֵם את פיו</he> so the Lord pricked his (Balaam’s) mouth (making him ‘go back’ to Balak); Tanḥ. Balak 13; Y’lamd. to Num. l. c., quot. in Ar. <he>היה פוקם … ופוקמה</he> (ed. Koh. <he>ופוקקה</he>, corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: same, to prick, perforate. Num. R. l. c. (ref. to Num. l. c. 5) שעיקם פיו ופִיקְּמוֹ וכ׳ he (the Lord) curved his mouth (as with a bit) and pierced it as a man drives a nail into a board; Yalk. ib. 765 עיקם את פיו ועקמו (corr. acc.).
